title: Sample: Cell Biology Review
intro: Welcome to your Commute Cram for cell biology. Two quick parts, a few questions, and you're done before your stop.

sections.heading: Mitochondria
sections.explain: Mitochondria run cellular respiration. They turn the energy in glucose into ATP, the molecule cells spend for energy. They even have their own small loop of DNA.

questions.q: What molecule do mitochondria make that cells use for energy?

sections.heading: Cell membranes
sections.explain: The cell membrane is a phospholipid bilayer. The heads love water and face out, the tails avoid water and face in, and proteins float in between to move things across.

questions.q: Which part of a phospholipid faces the water?
What is the membrane's structure called?

outro: Nice work. That's the review. You've got this.
